coverage.source_scope: Exact labelled support and review-cited paragraphs read through viewer; all20 passages exported in CASE files but not claiming all full passages independently semantically audited.

cases.label: TARGET_ENDPOINT_REPLACED_WITH_PARTLY_REASONABLE_EVIDENCE_DOUBT
cases.note: Local first two reviewers question explicit reservoir-to-border entailment but then incorrectly replace neighboring county with birthplace county; third supports correct candidate with misnumbered citations. Final Ashtabula.

cases.label: TARGET_ENDPOINT_REPLACED
cases.note: All local reviewers acknowledge county relation while choosing birthplace county Ashtabula; final same wrong endpoint. Same task as unit0, not independent replication.

cases.label: GENRE_TARGET_REINTERPRETED
cases.note: All local reviewers challenge gangsta rap and favor hip hop; P5 explicitly contrasts gangsta rap with West. Generic reviewers also largely challenge but expert retains correct gangsta rap. Local harm relative to G, no causal majority proof.

cases.label: GENRE_TARGET_REINTERPRETED_WITH_MIXED_REVIEW
cases.note: Local third reviewer labels CHALLENGE while concluding gangsta rap; others favor hip hop. Both G/L finals hip hop. Verdict is not reviewer answer correctness.

cases.label: TYPE_TO_ENTITY_SUBSTITUTION
cases.note: P10 directly calls Wyoming land-grant; local reviewers acknowledge that fact but select University of Wyoming. Generic slot2 still proposes land-grant under CHALLENGE, others favor name. G/L final name, S correct type.

cases.label: CORRECT_CANDIDATE_BAD_EXPLANATION_AND_REVISION_DRIFT
cases.note: Original explanation wrongly types magazine as university though candidate type correct. L/G challenge this then answer university name. S first two reviews correctly support type, third also supports with false quote; S final nevertheless university name. Not all loss uniquely attributable to ordinary reviews.

cases.label: BORDER_RELATION_ENDPOINT_SWAPPED
cases.note: L reviewers confuse birthplace county with requested neighboring county. G also has three wrong challenges yet final retains Greene; L final Ulster. Original explanation not the later seed Kingston-border misstatement.

cases.label: MIXED_LOCAL_SUPPORT_WITH_CITATION_ERROR
cases.note: Two L reviews favor Ulster; third supports Greene but repeats incorrect Kingston-border attribution. L final Greene whereas G final Ulster. Correct final is not a clean verified reasoning chain.

cases.label: CORRECT_FINAL_DESPITE_WRONG_LOCAL_RECOMMENDATIONS
cases.note: All three L reviews wrongly prefer newspaper founding1963 to university1960; L final nevertheless1960, G1963. Cannot credit a correct reviewer correction or automatic majority.

cases.label: PUBLICATION_VS_OWNER_DATE_CONFUSION
cases.note: Both G/L reviewers repeatedly conflate university and newspaper dates despite explicit P5/P9 distinction. All choose1963 rather than university1960; S retains1960.

cases.label: LANGUAGE_TARGET_STRENGTHENED_AND_GENERATION_ERROR
cases.note: Renana mother Ruth wrote English-language Householder. L shifts used language to native/spoken language or loses mother identity, yields no information. G reviews uncertain but final Italian unsupported as asked. Rationale is answer-only, no full expert reasoning.

cases.label: MOTHER_GRANDMOTHER_OR_WRITTEN_LANGUAGE_LINK_LOST
cases.note: L/G reviewers doubt available language link; some identify grandmother Mehraben as mother or ask mother-of-author. L unknown; G retains English despite all UNCERTAIN. Not a token/parser failure.

cases.label: BOUNDARY_AUTHOR_VS_GUIDE_AND_INCONSISTENT_EXPERT_EXPLANATION
cases.note: R1878 correct per frozen target, expert original explanation foregrounds wrong Yale Record1872. G/L reviewers instead ask guide founding and reject newspaper-to-author relationship. Some unsupported1962 from unrelated Notre Dame. S1872; G/Lunknown. Predeclared boundary.

cases.label: BOUNDARY_POSITIVE_EM_WITHOUT_VALID_RECOMMENDATION
cases.note: All L reviews CHALLENGE and suggest unknown/1962, yet final1878 correct; G1962. Only primary-background positive L-G comes from this predeclared boundary case, not observed clean local correction.

cases.label: PREDECLARED_LABEL_SCOPE_BOUNDARY_WITH_WRONG_REPLACEMENT
cases.note: Reprise linked to later album, valid scope concern for song-specific reading, while question asks performer label. L selects Capitol from unrelated MC Hammer or unsupported career assertion; Gunknown. Do not count every scope challenge as wholly false.

cases.label: PREDECLARED_LABEL_SCOPE_BOUNDARY_AND_WRONG_ENTITY_BINDING
cases.note: Same task boundary as29. L slot1/3 explicitly use MC Hammer P4 for Yoakam Capitol while slot2 rejects that substitute; finalCapitol. Gunknown. Original R correctness per official scoring not unqualified semantic certainty.

cases.label: ORDINARY_COMPLEMENT_WITH_MIXED_REASONING
cases.note: Wrong China bridge candidate. All ordinary prior answers Verrazano. G/L reviews restore USA/Verrazano with some erroneous direct Logan-bridge demands and Americas-country conflation; final correct. Self reviews include country recognition but wrong alternative bridges, final Fourth Nanjing. Sole extra correct unit vs S not due formatting.

cases.label: SCOPE_CORRECTION_NOT_UNIQUE_TO_LOCAL
cases.note: Golden Gate1937 world-record fact does not establish requested maximum. G/L and S all final Verrazano; ordinary reviews contain useful distinction plus unnecessary direct Logan-bridge demands. S has one valid Verrazano review and other errors.

cases.label: MIXED_VALID_FACTS_WRONG_RECOMMENDATION
cases.note: All L reviews explicitly state adoption2001 but conclude2004 (entry into force), while candidate1949 and expert explanation already2001. Expert final2001. Generic has one2001 and others2004; self all2001. Cannot call this new ordinary knowledge or wholesale review acceptance.

cases.label: MIXED_VALID_FACTS_WRONG_RECOMMENDATION
cases.note: All G/L reviewers say adoption2001 but recommend2004; expert final2001 in all arms. Original explanation already2001 and self reviews correct. Same task as26.

cases.label: DATE_TARGET_CORRECTION_AVAILABLE_IN_PREFIX
cases.note: Region1994 already in expert explanation versus candidate1966. L slot1 recognizes1994 yet says unavailable, slot2 recommends1966, slot3 correctly1994; G similar, S mixed. All finals1994. No unique local increment.

cases.label: OFFICIAL_EM_ONLY_UNIT_FORMAT
cases.note: Self final21 m vs official21; all reviewers support21 meters. Frozen auxiliary alias explicitly accepts21 m, so S loss here is not a semantic reasoning error. G/L21 correct.

cases.label: INTERMEDIATE_ENTITY_CORRECTED_WITHOUT_REQUIRED_NAME

cases.note: L corrects UN organization relative to TrusteeshipCouncil but answers UN, not requested label Four Policemen. GStatisticsDivision. Cannot call intermediate local progress final success.
